Name: Cheaper Pets
Author: DellyBelly
Description:
[b]Cheaper Pets[/b] lowers the cost of pets and pet bowls, helping you achieve your multi-pet dreams

[size=5][b]How to Install[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿﻿
[*]Download and unzip the mod into [i]Stardew Valley/Mods[/i]
>> alternatively consider using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10455]Stardrop [/url]﻿to manage your mods
[*]Run the game using SMAPI
[/list]
[size=5][b]Config Options[/b][/size]
The options are set up to be roughly "99% discount", "90% discount", "75% discount", "50% discount", "25% discount", "Full price"
[list]
[*]Pet price multiplier: 0.01, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0 (default: 0.1)
[*]Pet Bowl cost: 10, 1000, 2500 (default: 1000)
[*]Pet Bowl material: wood, stone, hardwood (default: wood)
[/list]
If you want to edit your config in-game then go get the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿. I believe you'll still need to exit the game and reload for the changes to take effect, but it will help avoid typos in the config file.[list]
[/list]
[size=5][b]Compatability[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+
[*]Do you have loads of pets now?! Grab some [size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22161]more pet bowls[/url]﻿[/size]

[/list]
[size=5][b]Translations[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]I have added a default.json file in the i18n folder
[/list][b] ﻿Modders:[/b][list]
[*]If you wish to make translations for the config of this mod, please create a json file of the language you're translating
[*]Offer your i18n folder and json file for download and make this mod a required download for your users
[*]See the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Modder_Guide/APIs/Translation#i18n_folder]wiki[/url]﻿ for more details
[/list]
[size=5][b]Thank you[/b][/size]
If you've made it this far and you install the mod, thank you. I hope you enjoy it.
And of course a big thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1552317]Pathoschild[/url] ﻿for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
